meta.name: alterlab-arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from expression matrices using arboreto's scalable GRNBoost2 and GENIE3 tree-ensemble algorithms with Dask-distributed computation. Use when analyzing bulk or single-cell RNA-seq transcriptomics to map transcription-factor-to-target-gene regulatory interactions, build adjacency networks, or run the GRN-inference step of a SCENIC pipeline on large datasets. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 从基因表达矩阵推断转录调控网络
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析RNA-seq数据并需要构建基因调控网络。
copy.tagline_en: Infer gene regulatory networks from expression matrices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing RNA-seq data to build gene regulatory networks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以根据你提供的基因表达数据，使用 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法推断基因调控网络，找出哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因，并输出调控关系表。
howto.when: 当你提供基因表达矩阵（如 RNA-seq 数据），并请求推断基因调控网络、构建邻接网络或运行 SCENIC 流程的 GRN 推断步骤时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRNBoost2 从这份表达数据推断基因调控网络。
用 GENIE3 算法分析这个单细胞表达矩阵。
say.note: Claude 会使用 GENIE3 算法进行推断。

say.text: 对这份表达数据，只考虑这些转录因子，运行 GRNBoost2。
say.note: Claude 会加载你提供的转录因子列表并限制推断范围。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can infer gene regulatory networks from expression matrices using GRNBoost2 or GENIE3 algorithms, identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes, and output a regulatory link table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a gene expression matrix (e.g., RNA-seq data) and request GRN inference, adjacency network construction, or the GRN-inference step of a SCENIC pipeline.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on this expression data to infer the regulatory network.
say_en.note: Claude will run GRNBoost2 and output TF-target links.

say_en.text: Analyze this single-cell expression matrix using GENIE3.
say_en.note: Claude will use the GENIE3 algorithm.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on this data, considering only these transcription factors.
say_en.note: Claude will load your TF list and restrict inference.
